title: Federated CI Failure Report
description: Emission contract for the federated CI failure auto-issue reporter (#199, src/events/federated_ci_watcher.ts in infrastructure/mcp-control-plane). A report is derived deterministically from a GitHub workflow_run.completed webhook event with conclusion == "failure" originating from a federation repository, and is normalized into a standard agent-task issue on the control-plane board (cross-repo task normalizer, #199 part 2). The report is the single source of truth for the issue title format, the label set, and the body contract; the machine surface (watcher) and this schema must evolve together.

schema.description: Report envelope version. Bump on any breaking field change.

repo.description: Full name of the repository whose workflow run failed (payload.repository.full_name).

workflowPath.description: Workflow definition path inside the failing repo (payload.workflow_run.path), when GitHub provides one.

runAttempt.description: Run attempt number (payload.workflow_run.run_attempt). Part of the dedupe key: a re-run of the same run id with a new attempt is a NEW failure signal.

headBranch.description: Branch the run was triggered on (payload.workflow_run.head_branch).

headSha.description: Full 40-hex head SHA the run was triggered on (payload.workflow_run.head_sha). Immutable failure anchor.

conclusion.description: Strict v1 policy: only conclusion == "failure" is reported. startup_failure/timed_out/cancelled are out of scope until a contract bump.

failedJobs.description: Best-effort enrichment from GET /repos/{repo}/actions/runs/{runId}/jobs?filter=latest. Empty array means enrichment was unavailable — the report itself must still be emitted (emission before enrichment, #199).

steps.description: Failed step names within the job (empty when the job failed before any step reported).

eventKey.description: Dedupe key ci-failure:<repo>:<workflowName>:<runId>:<runAttempt> — the idempotency anchor of the reporter (24h default TTL).

reportedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant at which the watcher accepted the event.

derivedIssue.title: Derived board issue (cross-repo task normalizer output)

title.description: Exact format: fix(ci): workflow failure in <repo-name> (<workflow-name> #<run_id>) — per issue #199.

labels.description: P1-high + handoff:coder + area:ci are always present (implicit claimable lifecycle per #222 — no status:unclaimed). repo:<slug> is best-effort and may be dropped by the 422 fallback.
